title: Backend engineering from first request to production
intro: Learn to design, build, test and operate a bookmark API. Start with a local request, then work through databases, identity, caching, Docker, Kubernetes and a release project.
how: Start with Python. Add Docker for the filesystem lab, then kind and kubectl for the local cluster. The data drills need only Python.

modules.title: Build and test your first service
modules.blurb: Start with one request, one durable row and a test.

modules.title: Release and recover a first version
modules.blurb: Follow the same row through a release and a storage incident.

modules.title: API contracts and relational databases
modules.blurb: Validate inputs, model owners, commit related changes and paginate results.

modules.title: Identity and changes over time
modules.blurb: Limit access by owner, expire sessions, refresh caches and migrate data.

modules.title: Docker, Kubernetes and production operations
modules.blurb: Package the service, replace a pod, measure performance and deliver your final project.

modules.blurb: A check at save time that detects a change since the client read a record.
